headline: Expanse Holds Hot as Linn Mercy, Mooring Stir Again
war_summary: Overnight wires show the pace easing in the Weathered Expanse to one transfer in two hours, nine in six and fifty-three on the day about Wightwalk, Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance for three Colonial, three Warden and three ruined posts, last heard at the hour, with day losses of 5,611 Colonial and 5,826 Warden now cooling. The Nevish Line also slows to two in two hours, eleven in six and twenty-nine on the day about Grief Mother, Blackcoat Way and Blinding Stones for four Colonial, three Warden and one ruined post, also last at the hour, with 9,750 Colonial and 11,714 Warden losses cooling. Linn Mercy stirs again with three in two hours and thirty-three on the day about Lathair and Outwich Ranch, last at 2351, while Mooring County rekindles with two about the Wind Hills, last at 2243, for a full Warden dozen. Stonecradle falls silent in two hours after eight in six about World's End, last at 2031, and Marban Hollow remains quiet since 0346, while Callahan's Passage and the Deadlands bleed heavily with no transfers.
